svg.aria-label: Timezone's panel hanging from the menu bar. The bead is dragged through the afternoon and every city's clock follows; then 9:00 is typed into San Francisco and every city moves to that moment: Pune 22:30, Berlin 18:00, Auckland 06:00 the next day. The desktop sky follows Pune's time.
svg.title: Timezone: see the sky over everyone you work with

g.text: Drag the bead through the day…
…or type a time into any city
9:00 in San Francisco is 22:30 in Pune
